@overview 字彙王 Level 3–5 練習題本。答案與中文詞義已與教材官方解答逐題核對；題目文字為照片轉錄。

@group A 文意字彙（1–5）：依提示寫出正確的字

Q 1 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Everyone cheered when the b______e and groom kissed each other in the wedding ceremony.
= bride
~詞義 bride（n.）新娘
~原文 Everyone cheered when the bride and groom kissed each other in the wedding ceremony.

Q 2 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Of all Italian dishes, s______i and pizza are the most well-known around the world.
= spaghetti
~詞義 spaghetti（n.）義大利麵
~原文 Of all Italian dishes, spaghetti and pizza are the most well-known around the world.

Q 3 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: You don't have to bring anything to the party. We have p______y of food and drink already.
= plenty
~詞義 plenty（n.）豐富;充分
~原文 You don't have to bring anything to the party. We have plenty of food and drink already.

Q 4 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: Those living in p______y often can't afford the basic necessities of life.
= poverty
~詞義 poverty（n.）貧窮
~原文 Those living in poverty often can't afford the basic necessities of life.

Q 5 | fill | 文意字彙
stem: If you want to return a product, you have to provide the r______t as proof that you actually bought it.
= receipt
~詞義 receipt（n.）收據
~原文 If you want to return a product, you have to provide the receipt as proof that you actually bought it.

@group B 選擇題（6–10）

Q 6 | choice | 選擇題
stem: Sarah was filled with ______ when she saw that her brother had gotten a big present, while she had not.
A: ditch
B: wagon
C: collar
D: envy
= D
~詞義 envy（n.）嫉妒
~原文 Sarah was filled with envy when she saw that her brother had gotten a big present, while she had not.

Q 7 | choice | 選擇題
stem: On warm autumn days, I like to sit by the lake and enjoy the cool ______ on my face.
A: ash
B: breeze
C: crown
D: fist
= B
~詞義 breeze（n.）微風
~原文 On warm autumn days, I like to sit by the lake and enjoy the cool breeze on my face.

Q 8 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The heat was so unbearable that Amy ______ and turned until sunrise, unable to find a comfortable position.
A: tossed
B: spilled
C: envied
D: drowned
= A
~詞義 toss（v.）翻來覆去;輾轉難眠(toss and turn)
~原文 The heat was so unbearable that Amy tossed and turned until sunrise, unable to find a comfortable position.

Q 9 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The chef added some ______ to the soup, and a wonderful smell filled the kitchen.
A: spices
B: bunches
C: pits
D: flames
= A
~詞義 spice（n.）香料
~原文 The chef added some spices to the soup, and a wonderful smell filled the kitchen.

Q 10 | choice | 選擇題
stem: The teacher asked the class to memorize several ______ from the poem to better appreciate its sound and meaning.
A: tutors
B: cocktails
C: ballets
D: verses
= D
~詞義 verse（n.）詩句
~原文 The teacher asked the class to memorize several verses from the poem to better appreciate its sound and meaning.

@group C 配合題（11–15）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: awful
B: bullets
C: crispy
D: dove
E: split
F: flame

Q 11 | bank | 配合題
stem: Don't let the children go near the ______, or they may accidentally burn themselves.
= F
~詞義 flame（n.）火焰
~原文 Don't let the children go near the flame, or they may accidentally burn themselves.

Q 12 | bank | 配合題
stem: The lifeguard ______ into the swimming pool to save the boy who didn't know how to swim.
= D
~詞義 dive（v.）跳水
~原文 The lifeguard dove into the swimming pool to save the boy who didn't know how to swim.

Q 13 | bank | 配合題
stem: Rick had a(n) ______ day at school. He forgot to bring his lunch, and then he twisted his ankle.
= A
~詞義 awful（adj.）糟糕的
~原文 Rick had a(n) awful day at school. He forgot to bring his lunch, and then he twisted his ankle.

Q 14 | bank | 配合題
stem: The doctor removed two ______ from the man who had been shot in the back.
= B
~詞義 bullet（n.）子彈
~原文 The doctor removed two bullets from the man who had been shot in the back.

Q 15 | bank | 配合題
stem: My mom makes really delicious potato chips. They are thin and ______, and the flavor is just right.
= C
~詞義 crispy（adj.）酥脆的
~原文 My mom makes really delicious potato chips. They are thin and crispy, and the flavor is just right.

@group C 配合題（16–20）：從單字庫選出最適合的字

@bank
A: spill
B: bunches
C: someday
D: reception
E: cocktail
F: blue-collar

Q 16 | bank | 配合題
stem: Billy's parents both worked ______ jobs, which taught him the value of physical labor and responsibility from a young age.
= F
~詞義 blue-collar（adj.）藍領階級的
~原文 Billy's parents both worked blue-collar jobs, which taught him the value of physical labor and responsibility from a young age.

Q 17 | bank | 配合題
stem: John carefully held the bottle for fear that he might ______ the water within.
= A
~詞義 spill（v.）灑出
~原文 John carefully held the bottle for fear that he might spill the water within.

Q 18 | bank | 配合題
stem: The martini is a(n) ______ that James Bond famously liked to drink.
= E
~詞義 cocktail（n.）雞尾酒
~原文 The martini is a(n) cocktail that James Bond famously liked to drink.

Q 19 | bank | 配合題
stem: ______ I hope to have enough money to buy that nice house.
= C
~詞義 someday（adv.）有一天
~原文 Someday I hope to have enough money to buy that nice house.

Q 20 | bank | 配合題
stem: The company holds a ______ party once a year to welcome new employees.
= D
~詞義 reception（n.）歡迎
~原文 The company holds a reception party once a year to welcome new employees.
